goal: Redesign the landing-page hero to feel more premium: stronger type hierarchy, more generous spacing, a confident headline. Each iteration, make the change, then render the page and save a screenshot to ./hero.png so it can be reviewed.
_note: Taste is a judgment call, so the gate is a human -- zero tokens, no LLM grading its own screenshots. The worker produces hero.png once per pass; you look and either approve or give feedback that is remembered for the next pass. Requires an interactive terminal (not for scheduled runs). See docs/GATES.md.

human_gate.prompt: Does the hero look premium? Approve to finish, or tell me exactly what's off (spacing, weight, color, copy).
